Application Data.NAME: Creative Lens Photography
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Creative Lens Photography specializes in high-quality portrait and event photography, offering services including family portraits, weddings, and corporate events. The studio is equipped with professional lighting and backdrops to create stunning visuals. We prioritize safety and operational standards by conducting regular training for employees and ensuring compliance with insurance requirements for any subcontractors used for specific projects. Our studio strictly adheres to environmental regulations and does not utilize any non-native or invasive plant species in our artwork or displays.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 08/15/2023, the studio experienced water damage due to a burst pipe, resulting in $5,000 in repair costs. The incident was promptly addressed, and repairs were completed by 09/01/2023. No ongoing issues or claims remain from this incident.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, UL listed, fire rated, located in a secure area with restricted access.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing and Security Cameras Installed, Regular Patrols by Security Personnel, Employee Training on Safety Protocols
